CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate assignment), its presented organization, and an origin/status field are all explicitly stated for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition tied to content presentation/access is present.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit coordinate assignments identify content (color) and attribute.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are provided separately from coordinate content, distinguishing identification from status/provenance.

O.rationale: The report states how content is presented (coordinate sets, axis conventions) and shows organized pattern membership.
